notes: No resistor is used: the pushbutton relies on the Arduino's internal pull-up (INPUT_PULLUP) on pin 2.
The pushbutton straddles the breadboard centre gap, with legs in rows 23 and 25 (columns E and F). Row 23 is side 1 (to GND) and row 25 is side 2 (to pin 2), as in the image and schematic.

The black wire goes from the GND header next to AREF (GND.1) to row 23, column A. The yellow wire goes from pin 2 to row 25, column A. The exact column used within a row is an estimate because all of A-E are the same strip.
The USB cable that powers the board and carries serial data is not shown in the images, so it is not included.
